checks.missing_dependency: a required addon is neither in the zip nor in the index
checks.missing_files: the TOC lists files that are not in the zip
checks.no_addon: the app finds no addon folder with a .toc in the zip (an entry whose zip has no .toc at all is left out of the index)
checks.no_forever_toc: no folder has a _Forever or _Camelot TOC or Interface 160xx, so the game may call it out of date
checks.not_forever: left out: a zip guessed from asset names whose TOCs are not for Forever (likely a retail or classic build)
checks.placeholder: unreplaced packager tokens such as @project-version@ in the TOC (zipped without the packager)
checks.repack: left out: a zip guessed from asset names that ships the folder of another repo's verified Forever build
checks.shared_folder: another repo in the index installs the same folder, so one overwrites the other
checks.zip_error: the release zip could not be read
